title: And it's coming from the snacks that feel the most normal to hand them
summary: Most kids are eating way more sugar than you realize... and it's coming from the snacks that feel the most normal to hand them.
caption: Most kids are eating way more sugar than you realize... and it's coming from the snacks that feel the most normal to hand them. 👀 Fruit by the Foot has 10 grams of added sugar per serving. That's already more than the entire recommended daily limit for kids and it's just one snack. The swap is simple. Same grab and go convenience, no added sugar, and kids adjust to it faster than you would expect. You don't need to throw out everything in your pantry to start making a dent. One swap at a time is how this actually works. Follow for daily tips on feeding your family healthier options.
